method: Box-office figures from Box Office Mojo (worldwide, current totals); sources differ slightly by data date and re-releases. Release date from Disney's film page, checked 2026-11-12. Pages not re-opened from this container. Check before publishing.

claims.claim: The Avengers (2012) was the first Marvel Studios film to bring its separate heroes together in one film. It grossed about $1.52 billion worldwide ($1,518,812,988).

sources.title: Box Office Mojo: The Avengers franchise
The Numbers: Box office history for Avengers movies

claims.claim: Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015) grossed about $1.40 billion worldwide; Avengers: Infinity War (2018) about $2.05 billion.

sources.title: Box Office Mojo: The Avengers franchise
The Numbers: Box office history for Avengers movies

contradictions: Some outlets round Infinity War to $2.1 billion.

claims.claim: Avengers: Endgame (2019) grossed about $2.8 billion worldwide ($2,799,439,100, Box Office Mojo), one of the highest-grossing films ever.

sources.title: Box Office Mojo: The Avengers franchise
The Numbers: Box office history for Avengers movies

contradictions: The Numbers and DIRECTV list about $2.72 billion; the gap is data dates and re-release totals.
claims.notes: Say 'about $2.8 billion' and 'one of the biggest', not 'the biggest'.

claims.claim: Together the four Avengers films grossed about $7.8 billion worldwide (the sum of C1 to C3: $7.77 billion).

sources.title: Box Office Mojo: The Avengers franchise

claims.claim: Avengers: Doomsday is due in cinemas on 18 December 2026 (United States), moved from 1 May 2026; Avengers: Secret Wars is due on 17 December 2027.

sources.title: Variety: Marvel pushes Doomsday and Secret Wars to December 2026 and 2027

contradictions: Some cinemas outside the US list 16 December 2026.
